import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes = {n['node_id']: n for n in data['architecture_nodes']['data']}
edges = data['architecture_edges']['data']
gov_controls = data['governance_controls']['data']
transforms = data['transformation_summary']['data']

# ---- COLORS ----
C = {
    'src': '#1E40AF', 'ing': '#0E7490', 'brz': '#92400E',
    'slv': '#374151', 'gld': '#B45309', 'con': '#065F46', 'gov': '#7C3AED'
}
CBG = {
    'src': '#DBEAFE', 'ing': '#CFFAFE', 'brz': '#FEF3C7',
    'slv': '#E5E7EB', 'gld': '#FEF3C7', 'con': '#A7F3D0'
}
MODE_C = {'streaming': '#2563EB', 'batch': '#059669', 'cdc': '#D97706', 'query': '#7C3AED'}

CAT_COLORS = ['#1E40AF', '#2563EB', '#3B82F6', '#6366F1', '#7C3AED']
CAT_NAMES = ['IoT / Streaming', 'Enterprise Apps', 'Logs / Clickstream', 'External / 3rd Party', 'Databases']
CAT_VOLS = [450, 250, 530, 95, 235]
CAT_DETAILS = [
    'IoT Sensors (450 GB) · JSON/Avro',
    'ERP (120) + CRM (85) + Files (45) · 250 GB',
    'App Logs (320) + Clickstream (210) · 530 GB',
    'Social (60) + Market (35) · 95 GB',
    'RDBMS (95) + NoSQL (140) · 235 GB'
]

# ---- FIGURE ----
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(32, 44), dpi=150)
ax = fig.add_axes([0.04, 0.02, 0.66, 0.96])
ax.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 43)
ax.axis('off')

ax_g = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.02, 0.27, 0.96])
ax_g.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax_g.set_ylim(0, 43)
ax_g.axis('off')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FFFFFF')

# ---- TITLE ----
ax.text(8, 42.2, 'Data Lakehouse Architecture', fontsize=32, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', color='#111827', family='sans-serif')
ax.text(8, 41.3, 'End-to-End Data Pipeline  ·  Medallion Architecture  ·  Governance Overlay',
        fontsize=15, ha='center', color='#6B7280')
ax.text(8, 40.6, 'Edge thickness indicates data volume  ·  Edge color indicates processing mode  ·  Daily averages',
        fontsize=11, ha='center', color='#9CA3AF')

# ---- LAYER POSITIONS ----
LY = {'src': 38.5, 'ing': 33.0, 'brz': 27.2, 'slv': 21.2, 'gld': 15.2, 'con': 9.0}
LH = {'src': 3.2, 'ing': 2.8, 'brz': 3.5, 'slv': 3.5, 'gld': 3.5, 'con': 3.5}
LNAME = {
    'src': 'DATA SOURCES — 5 Categories',
    'ing': 'INGESTION LAYER',
    'brz': 'BRONZE — Raw Zone',
    'slv': 'SILVER — Curated Zone',
    'gld': 'GOLD — Business Zone',
    'con': 'CONSUMPTION ENDPOINTS'
}
LVOL = {'src': '1,560 GB/day', 'ing': '1,735 GB/day', 'brz': '1,560 GB/day',
        'slv': '445 GB/day', 'gld': '32 GB/day', 'con': 'Query-based access'}

for lk in ['src', 'ing', 'brz', 'slv', 'gld', 'con']:
    yc, h = LY[lk], LH[lk]
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, yc - h/2), 15.4, h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor=CBG[lk],
                          edgecolor=C[lk], linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.55, zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(0.8, yc + h/2 - 0.3, LNAME[lk], fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
            color=C[lk], va='top', ha='left', zorder=5)
    ax.text(15.2, yc + h/2 - 0.3, LVOL[lk], fontsize=11, color=C[lk],
            va='top', ha='right', fontstyle='italic', zorder=5)

# ---- HELPER ----
npos = {}

def node(x, y, lines, color, w=2.4, h=0.78):
    tc = '#FFFFFF'
    r, g, b = matplotlib.colors.to_rgb(color)
    if r*0.299 + g*0.587 + b*0.114 > 0.6:
        tc = '#1F2937'
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.1", facecolor=color,
                          edgecolor='#FFFFFF', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.95, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    nl = len(lines)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        off = (nl - 1) / 2 - i
        fw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        fs = 8.5 if i == 0 else 7.5
        ax.text(x, y + off * 0.24, line, fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw,
                ha='center', va='center', color=tc, zorder=4, family='sans-serif')

def edge(sx, sy, tx, ty, vol=None, mode=None, label=None):
    if mode:
        ec = MODE_C.get(mode, '#9CA3AF')
    elif vol and vol > 200:
        ec = '#3B82F6'
    else:
        ec = '#6B7280'

    if vol and vol > 400: lw = 4.0
    elif vol and vol > 200: lw = 3.0
    elif vol and vol > 100: lw = 2.2
    elif vol and vol > 50: lw = 1.5
    elif vol: lw = 1.0
    else: lw = 0.8; ec = '#C4B5FD'

    alpha = 0.55 if vol and vol > 100 else 0.35
    ax.annotate('', xy=(tx, ty + 0.39), xytext=(sx, sy - 0.39),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
                               connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.02', alpha=alpha), zorder=2)
    if label or (vol and vol >= 80):
        mx, my = (sx + tx) / 2, (sy + ty) / 2
        txt = label or str(vol)
        ax.text(mx + 0.2, my, f'{txt} GB', fontsize=6.5, color=ec,
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold', alpha=0.75, zorder=5)

# ---- SOURCE NODES ----
sy = LY['src'] - 0.6
sxs = [1.8, 4.7, 7.6, 10.5, 13.4]
for i in range(5):
    lines = [CAT_NAMES[i], f'{CAT_VOLS[i]} GB/day']
    node(sxs[i], sy, lines, CAT_COLORS[i], w=2.5, h=0.8)
    npos[f'cat_{i}'] = (sxs[i], sy)
    # Detail annotation below node
    ax.text(sxs[i], sy - 0.65, CAT_DETAILS[i], fontsize=6.5, ha='center',
            va='center', color='#4B5563', fontstyle='italic', zorder=5)

# ---- INGESTION NODES ----
iy = LY['ing'] - 0.4
ing_info = [
    ('ing_batch', 3.5, ['Batch Ingestion', 'Spark / ADF  ·  520 GB/day']),
    ('ing_stream', 8.0, ['Stream Ingestion', 'Kafka / EventHub  ·  980 GB/day']),
    ('ing_cdc', 12.5, ['CDC Connector', 'Debezium  ·  235 GB/day']),
]
for nid, x, lines in ing_info:
    node(x, iy, lines, C['ing'], w=3.2, h=0.8)
    npos[nid] = (x, iy)

# Mode badges
for x, label in [(3.5, 'BATCH'), (8.0, 'STREAMING'), (12.5, 'CDC')]:
    ax.text(x, iy + 0.7, label, fontsize=9, ha='center', color='#0E7490', fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# ---- BRONZE NODES ----
by = LY['brz'] - 0.6
brz_info = [
    ('brz_raw_iot', 1.8, ['Raw IoT Events', '450 GB/day']),
    ('brz_raw_txn', 4.7, ['Raw Transactions', '300 GB/day']),
    ('brz_raw_logs', 7.6, ['Raw Log Data', '530 GB/day']),
    ('brz_raw_ext', 10.5, ['Raw External Data', '95 GB/day']),
    ('brz_raw_db', 13.4, ['Raw DB Snapshots', '185 GB/day']),
]
for nid, x, lines in brz_info:
    node(x, by, lines, C['brz'], w=2.5, h=0.75)
    npos[nid] = (x, by)

# Transform annotation
brz_t = [t for t in transforms if t['layer'] == 'bronze']
ts = '   '.join([f"{t['transformation_type'].replace('(Append-Only)','').strip()}: {t['count']}" for t in brz_t])
ax.text(8, LY['brz'] - LH['brz']/2 + 0.3, f'23 Transforms (Low) — {ts}',
        fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#92400E', zorder=5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='#FFFBEB', alpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D97706'))

# ---- SILVER NODES ----
svy = LY['slv'] - 0.6
slv_info = [
    ('slv_cleaned_iot', 1.8, ['Cleaned IoT Metrics', '180 GB/day']),
    ('slv_unified_customer', 4.7, ['Unified Customer 360', '45 GB/day']),
    ('slv_sessionized_clicks', 7.6, ['Sessionized Clickstream', '90 GB/day']),
    ('slv_enriched_txn', 10.5, ['Enriched Transactions', '110 GB/day']),
    ('slv_normalized_market', 13.4, ['Normalized Market Data', '20 GB/day']),
]
for nid, x, lines in slv_info:
    node(x, svy, lines, C['slv'], w=2.5, h=0.75)
    npos[nid] = (x, svy)

slv_t = [t for t in transforms if t['layer'] == 'silver']
ts = '   '.join([f"{t['transformation_type']}: {t['count']}" for t in slv_t])
ax.text(8, LY['slv'] - LH['slv']/2 + 0.3, f'34 Transforms (Med-High) — {ts}',
        fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#374151', zorder=5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='#F9FAFB', alpha=0.95, edgecolor='#6B7280'))

# ---- GOLD NODES ----
gy = LY['gld'] - 0.6
gld_info = [
    ('gld_revenue_agg', 1.8, ['Revenue Aggregates', '8 GB/day']),
    ('gld_customer_ltv', 4.7, ['Customer LTV Scores', '3 GB/day']),
    ('gld_anomaly_features', 7.6, ['Anomaly Detection Features', '12 GB/day']),
    ('gld_product_perf', 10.5, ['Product Performance KPIs', '5 GB/day']),
    ('gld_marketing_attr', 13.4, ['Marketing Attribution', '4 GB/day']),
]
for nid, x, lines in gld_info:
    node(x, gy, lines, C['gld'], w=2.5, h=0.75)
    npos[nid] = (x, gy)

gld_t = [t for t in transforms if t['layer'] == 'gold']
ts = '   '.join([f"{t['transformation_type']}: {t['count']}" for t in gld_t])
ax.text(8, LY['gld'] - LH['gld']/2 + 0.3, f'30 Transforms (Med-High) — {ts}',
        fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#92400E', zorder=5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='#FFFBEB', alpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D97706'))

# ---- CONSUMPTION NODES ----
cy = LY['con'] - 0.6
con_info = [
    ('con_dashboard', 1.5, ['Executive Dashboards', 'Power BI / Tableau']),
    ('con_adhoc', 4.2, ['Ad-hoc SQL Analytics', 'Serverless SQL']),
    ('con_ml_train', 6.9, ['ML Training Pipelines', 'MLflow / Spark ML']),
    ('con_ml_serve', 9.6, ['ML Serving Endpoints', 'REST API']),
    ('con_data_api', 12.0, ['Data API Services', 'GraphQL / REST']),
    ('con_reverse_etl', 14.2, ['Reverse ETL to SaaS', 'Census / Hightouch']),
]
# Category headers
for lbl, x1, x2 in [('BI Analytics', 1.5, 4.2), ('Machine Learning', 6.9, 9.6), ('API & Integration', 12.0, 14.2)]:
    ax.text((x1+x2)/2, cy + 0.7, lbl, fontsize=9, ha='center', color='#065F46', fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

for nid, x, lines in con_info:
    node(x, cy, lines, C['con'], w=2.3, h=0.75)
    npos[nid] = (x, cy)

# ---- EDGES ----
# Source categories -> Ingestion (aggregated)
src_ing = [
    (0, 'ing_stream', 450, 'streaming'),   # IoT -> Stream
    (1, 'ing_batch', 250, 'batch'),         # Enterprise -> Batch
    (2, 'ing_stream', 530, 'streaming'),    # Logs -> Stream
    (3, 'ing_batch', 60, 'batch'),          # External -> Batch (Social)
    (3, 'ing_stream', 35, 'streaming'),     # External -> Stream (Market)
    (4, 'ing_cdc', 235, 'cdc'),            # Databases -> CDC
]
for cat_i, tgt, vol, mode in src_ing:
    sx, sy_ = npos[f'cat_{cat_i}']
    tx, ty_ = npos[tgt]
    edge(sx, sy_, tx, ty_, vol=vol, mode=mode)

# Ingestion -> Bronze
ing_brz = [
    ('ing_stream', 'brz_raw_iot', 450),
    ('ing_stream', 'brz_raw_logs', 530),
    ('ing_batch', 'brz_raw_txn', 300),
    ('ing_batch', 'brz_raw_ext', 95),
    ('ing_cdc', 'brz_raw_db', 185),
    ('ing_stream', 'brz_raw_ext', 35),
]
for s, t, v in ing_brz:
    sx, sy_ = npos[s]; tx, ty_ = npos[t]
    edge(sx, sy_, tx, ty_, vol=v)

# Bronze -> Silver
brz_slv = [
    ('brz_raw_iot', 'slv_cleaned_iot', 180),
